description: This file implements network device traffic monitoring, including data collection, list management, and periodic reporting via threads. It manages traffic data, interacts with system scripts, and handles synchronization for harvesting network traffic information.

methods.name: WaitForPthreadConditionTimeoutNDT
methods.description: Waits for a condition variable with a timeout based on the polling period.

methods.name: isvalueinarray_ndt
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array of ULONGs.

methods.name: ResetEBTables
methods.description: Resets Ethernet bridge tables by executing a system script and updates the reset timestamp.

methods.name: SetNDTHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables network device traffic harvesting, starting or stopping the harvesting thread accordingly.

methods.name: GetNDTHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of network device traffic harvesting.

methods.name: SetNDTReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period for network device traffic data.

methods.name: GetNDTReportingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current reporting period.

methods.name: SetNDTPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period for data collection.

methods.name: ValidateNDTPeriod
methods.description: Validates if a given period is within the allowed set of periods.

methods.name: GetNDTPollingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the current polling period.

methods.name: SetNDTReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period.

methods.name: GetNDTReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default reporting period.

methods.name: SetNDTPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period.

methods.name: GetNDTPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default polling period.

methods.name: GetNDTOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default TTL value.

methods.name: GetNDTOverrideTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the current TTL value.

methods.name: SetNDTOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the TTL value.

methods.name: add_to_list_ndt
methods.description: Parses a line of IP table data and adds it to the linked list.

methods.name: print_list_ndt
methods.description: Prints all nodes in the linked list for debugging.

methods.name: delete_list_ndt
methods.description: Deletes all nodes in the linked list, freeing memory.

methods.name: delete_partial_list_ndt
methods.description: Deletes list entries that are not from the last polling cycle, retaining recent data.

methods.name: GetIPTableData
methods.description: Executes system scripts to gather current IP traffic data and populates the linked list.

methods.name: StartNetworkDevicesTrafficHarvesting
methods.description: Main thread function that periodically collects, reports, and manages network device traffic data.
